cycle.blurb: Are you an undergraduate student? A writer? An artist? Sapient would love to publish your art or essay in our next journal or on our blog! Volume 13 will be digitally published in the Spring 2026 semester.

volumes.label: Volume Thirteen
volumes.headline: Volume Thirteen is published!
volumes.note:
Sapient is thrilled to announce the publication of the journal's thirteenth volume.

To our readers: thank you for making our work worthwhile. We hope you appreciate this edition of Sapient as much as we enjoyed creating it.
